WEBSITE INFORMATION

Your privacy.

How this website handles your enquiry.

Enquiry details

The enquiry form prepares a WhatsApp message using the details you enter. This website does not save form entries in a database or send them to our team automatically. You review and send the message yourself in WhatsApp.

WhatsApp and Instagram

When you follow a WhatsApp or Instagram link, you leave this website. The respective service’s privacy terms and account settings apply. Information you send directly to Purple Fox is used to discuss your enquiry and event requirements.

Website hosting

The hosting provider may process ordinary request information, such as IP addresses and browser details, to serve and secure the website. This site does not add advertising trackers or visitor analytics. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts.

Images and client information

Current gallery images are AI-generated concepts. Actual client photographs and testimonials will be published only after approval.

Questions

For questions about your enquiry or a request concerning information you have shared, contact Purple Fox on WhatsApp.
